desc: The 30mm ROF-SAR is a drop-in upgrade for 30mm optics. The ROF-SAR adds a mounting point for an AIMPOINT Micro (T1-T2-CompM5) to provide for quick transition to a non-magnified optic for close-range target engagement. The ROF-SAR allows for user to orient the Micro optic at their desired orientation around the magnified optic.
